item.description: A total of 42 students from across Schuylkill County will take the stage this Saturday to compete in the 2026 Northeast PA Manufacturers & Employers Council Regional Spelling Bee, coordinated by the Schuylkill Technology Center. item.title: One Injured in Rollover Crash in Mahanoy City
item.description: One person was transported to hospital Thursday night in a rollover crash in Mahanoy City.At 9:40pm, Thursday, emergency personnel were called to a motor vehicle accident with rollover in the 1100 Block of East Centre Street in Mahanoy City.Fire and police arrived on scene to find a vehicle on it's driver's side in the middle of the street.The driver was extricated by emergency personnel and transported to the hospital with unknown injuries.Submitted Photo
